items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: And what other player played trumpet? Willie Webber.

ctx.x: Willie Wilson. Willie Wilson and Zeo. I call it Zeno. Yeah, Zeno played trumpet. And what other player played trumpet? Willie Webber. Willie Wilson. Willie Wilson. Willie Wilson. Oh, I see. Good. Willie Wilson. And Tom Albert played? Huh? Tom Albert. Tom Albert. And Tom Albert played?
Huh? Tom Albert. And Tom Albert played? Huh? Tom Albert. Yeah. When, when was he with you? Huh? When was Tom Albert with you?
